notes.title: Nintendo Switch™ Standard Edition Package/Special Limited Edition on sale today!
notes.notes:
The Nintendo Switch™ packaged version of Touhou Genso Wanderer -FORESIGHT- is now available!

A "Special Limited Edition" packed with great bonuses will also be released at the same time as the "Standard Edition".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906755/124bd094b0a2b7895dac9441579da6e0ae0d89b9.png[/img]

The luxurious specifications of the special limited edition are as follows!
[list]
[*]Special limited edition storage box
[*]Main game (Nintendo Switch™ package standard version)
[*]Original soundtrack + secret
[*]Art book
[*]Key visual acrylic diorama stand set
[*]Product code for 2 DLC costumes
[/list]

Play the latest in the classic dungeon exploration RPG series of "Touhou Project" fan games, which pursues a "Roguelite" style that allows anyone to easily enjoy dungeon exploration, on your Nintendo Switch™ machine!

In addition, updates will be released soon for all Switch, PS4, and Steam versions!
Dungeons that allow you to understand the game system more carefully while playing, high-difficulty dungeons that you can play after clearing, dungeons with slightly unusual concepts, and more will be added in mid-December, with a variety of types and volume to play thoroughly!

Stay tuned!

*Quantities are limited. Please note that sales will end once stock runs out.

notes.title: Update Letter　Vol.2
notes.notes:
Touhou Genso Wanderer -FORESIGHT-” was released in May of this year, and the Nintendo Switch™/PlayStation®4 DL version will be available from today, September 19, Japan time.
To coincide with this, we have made the following additions and adjustments as a version update so that Steam players will be able to play the same content as the CS version.

We have been working on this version for a long time since its release in May, and have received a lot of feedback from many people during the post-release period.
We deeply apologize for the lack of development in some areas since the release, and we hope that what you are looking for is in your hands and that you will enjoy playing the game for a long time.

The current update status is as follows,

[h3][FIX][/h3]
[list]
[*]Conditions for obtaining the achievement “Road to Saikyo” were modified (Ver. 1.07)
[*]Various minor problems were corrected (Ver1.07 - Ver1.08)
[*]Typographical errors were corrected (Ver1.07 - Ver1.08)
[/list]

[h3][Addition][/h3]
[list]
[*]Added special dungeon (Ver1.07)
[*]Added the effect of the pond in the Hakurei renovation project (Ver1.08)
[*]Added dungeon (Ver1.08)
[*]Added sub-scenarios (Ver. 1.08)
[*]Added multiple spell cards (Ver. 1.08)
[*]Added some cut-in effects (Ver. 1.08)
[*]Added maximum boss level for some dungeons (Ver. 1.08)
[*]Brushed up some graphics (Ver. 1.08)
[/list]

The major updates will be the addition of additional dungeons, additional characters, sub-scenarios, and the effects of the Hakurei renovation project.
As for some cut-ins, the popular boss characters will be more gorgeously presented to give the game a more lively feel.In addition, the cut-ins will be itemized as spell cards that players will be able to use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906755/124be9d92c50689d54e182ba5adc63e6b128d9bc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906755/ad5b09daf9ab609de5b544c648ad8b6ce728391c.jpg[/img]

Please enjoy “Fushigen” as much as you like!

notes.title: Update Letter Vol.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906755/de185ee73ce27f1f0cfdb145de0267cf39f6cbfe.png[/img]
Following its initial announcement and the first secret playable demo at an event both in March, Touhou Genso Wanderer -Foresight- released in May.
From the playable demo version to the May release, various adjustments, fixes, and additions were made leading to this version's release.
We deeply apologize for the state of development post-release and for not being able to meet all player expectations.

Current updates are as follows:


[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Corrected typos. (Ver. 1.01 to Ver 1.05)
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented the screen from displaying properly in full-screen mode. (Ver. 1.01)
[*] Fixed the error message not displaying when save data cannot be written. (Ver 1.02)
[*] Fixed a bug that occurred when selling and purchasing gaps at a base shop. (Ver 1.03)
[*] Fixed Magic Circles generated in some boss dungeons where it was impossible to suspend. (Ver 1.03)
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some skill animations now play faster. (Ver 1.03)
[*] Adjusted enemy skills. (Ver 1.05)
[/list]

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the Izanagi Old Well and Hakurei Shrine Old Well dungeons. (Ver 1.05)
[/list]


The major post-release update will feature dungeons with 99 floors you cannot bring things into.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906755/80a32b5e83ed0d358560b17e293cb95e5e3626fb.jpg[/img]
These dungeons are the Izanagi Old Well and Hakurei Shrine Old Well.
You will unlock Izanagi Link on one of the Izanagi Old Well floors and use the links to get to the 99th floor.
The Hakurei Shrine Old Well dungeon is standard like past series with no Izanagi Link. It also features 99 floors you cannot bring things into.
These old well dungeons eventually unlock as you make progress in the game. Do try taking on these tough dungeons that have a different feel from the main story!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906755/28a77d2755a09b09751ff779d1253ebd58c08252.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906755/da302bd40fbc0cb73a58b31f21f746c82a665caf.jpg[/img]

In addition to the Old Well dungeons, there will be more post-completion dungeons to come.
Keep an eye out for future updates!

notes.title: 【Infomation】About the crash at the start of the game
notes.notes:
We are currently receiving reports that the game crashes when starting a new game in some environments.

One of the reasons for this report is that the security software installed on the PC running the game is blocking the writing of saved data.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
If you are using Windows Defender or third-party security software, please check the Notification Center to see if it is blocking the game's save data from being written.

notes.title: The second PV features the theme song "Memento"!
notes.notes:
The theme song "Memento" for Touhou Genso Wanderer -FORESIGHT- has been decided.
The song will be sung by Nami Nakagawa, who is well known for her "Kamado Tanjiro No Uta" the Hearthmaker!
The song is composed by Tatsuyuki Toyota, a well-known composer of the Toho Genso Wanderer series, and the lyrics are written by Yasuhiro Takaoki.


The theme song will be "Memento", an original song newly drawn for the event! 
The theme song "Memento" will be premiered in the latest trailer that will be shown at the booth on the day of the event! 
Please come to the booth and enjoy the beautiful, fleeting, and sad melody that is typical of the "Touhou Genso Wanderer" series. 
 
Song: Naomi Nakagawa 
[url=http://nakagawanami.com/]Official Site[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906755/78a61a684f128ccf8779072299680b4bbc56de3f.jpg[/img]
< Career >
Tourism Ambassador of Ehime Prefecture and Cultural Ambassador of Uwajima City.
Representative songs: "Kamado Tanjiro No Uta" and "Kamado Nezuko no Uta", insert songs for the anime "Demon Slayer：Kimetsu no Yaiba".
Wrote and sang "Proud Hero", the ending theme song for the TV animation "The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki Northern War", and sang for Tales of, Taiko Drum Master, GOD EATER, NieR, and other series.
As an "edutainer" who encourages children's shining growth and as an "artist lecturer" who gives lectures with singing, she is working with the philosophy of "making the world happy through art". Published a book "The Magic of the Voice to Make Your Wishes Come True" to make people happy with their voices. 
 
< Comment >
Since the series has been loved for a long time, I wanted to respect the world view of the series. 
I am sure that the song is filled with the feelings of many people, so I sang it with the "love" of many people and with respect for all the people who have been involved in the series. 
The ethnic chorus full of Japanese taste and the airy, gentle chorus are the key to connecting with the fantastic world of "Somewhere but Now. I hope those who listen will enjoy this mysterious fantasy world. We hope that those who are not feeling well will be cheered up and those who are hurting will be healed even if only a little!



Composer : Tatsuyuki Toyota
[url=https://ostvintz.com/]Official Site[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906755/e2435dfc5183c309a7461b22d5cadaee0ade137c.jpg[/img]
< Career >
Graduated from Osaka University of Arts in 2006, majoring in film sound.
Studied composition techniques under composer and guitarist Hideaki Yahagi. 
After working on sound production for amusement machines, worked as a sound creator at Beck Corporation (now B.B. Studio Co., Ltd.), then took charge of many projects as a sound director/composer/sound engineer (Super Robot Wars series, Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation2 series / Touhou Genso Wanderer series). 
Based on jazz theory, he has worked on all genres of music, including orchestral rock, jazz, EDM, and ethnic music with a Hollywood flavor. 
In addition to creating sound effects using Foley, he is also a generalist who implements sound using various sound middleware (Wwise, CRI_ADX), Unity, and UE5. 
 
< Comment >
For the first time in five years, I have sung the theme song for the "Touhou Genso Wanderer" series. 
This time, the theme song is linked to the emotions of Reimu, the main character in the game, and I believe I have created a beautiful melody that complements the story. 
Nami Nakagawa sang vocals, Yasuhiro Takaoki wrote the lyrics, MIZ played Violin & Viola, and Masatsugen Watanabe played Cello. The collaboration of these wonderful players is also a must-listen! 
Whether you are playing "Touhou Genso Wanderer" for the first time or for the first time in a while, we hope you will immerse yourself in the world of "Touhou Genso Wanderer" while listening to the theme song! 



Lyricist : Yasuhiro Takaoki 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906755/a5d5b1bbe49ea813bf91e1e74b27766cbc72d2a8.png[/img]
< Career >
sakushikaActivated as a "sakushika" to support business development and realization of dreams by clarifying and verbalizing thoughts and aspirations.
In addition to producing the publication "AKASHI, a book that preserves living proof," he writes websites and LPs that generate results from empathy, and supports crowdfunding.
He is also expanding his activities by providing lyrics as a songwriter and producing picture books.
 
< Comment >
Thank you very much for allowing me to participate in the world of Touhou Project!
From the story of "Touhou Genso Wanderer -FORESIGHT-", I strongly felt the bond with the fans who love the work, and I felt as if I had touched the origin of the work.
Like the waves that come and go, our destiny may be constantly shifting and repeating itself. Encounters that color our lives, conflicts and human karma that continue through the ages. I wrote the lyrics for the universal wishes that people hold in the midst of these encounters.
With fantastic and powerful music and Nami Nakagawa's beautiful voice, I believe that this work resonates a message that transcends time and space to the world.
Reimu and Marisa's nostalgic yet new adventures will surely become unforgettable memories. Let's embark on a journey to the Genso Wanderer with this song!

notes.title: Touhou Genso Wanderer -Foresight- is coming May 15, 2024!
notes.notes:
Touhou Genso Wanderer -Foresight-, the latest title in the Touhou Project series of fan-made games, has been announced to release May 15.

Touhou Genso Wanderer -Foresight- is a dungeon-crawler RPG featuring Touhou Project characters.
The game emphasizes elements of traditional dungeon-crawler RPGs and introduces gameplay mechanics designed to make it easy for casual players to enjoy.

In addition to new character illustrations, the majority of the weapons and armor have new drawings too!
Almost all character skill activations and effects that are central to gameplay have also been revamped.

If this piques your interest, don't hesitate to add the game to your wishlist and check back for further updates!
